requirement.title: WBFT quorum size calculation
requirement.statement: QuorumSize is exactly ceil(N - F) with F = (N-1)/3; the live code computes it in float64 via math.Ceil (default.go:226). Any alternative formula must yield the identical value for every N.

requirement.title: WBFT Core lock discipline — never read Core.current off currentMutex
requirement.statement: Reads of c.current or its subfields must hold currentMutex.RLock or the encompassing currentMutex.Lock write region; writes must hold currentMutex.Lock for the full mutation. Holding only priorState.RWMutex does not satisfy this requirement.
